name: NGC 4033 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4033, an elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4033-hubble
story: An elliptical galaxy in a sparse part of space, far from crowded clusters. Hubble studied the swarm of globular star clusters around it, which likely fall into two distinct populations.

claims.text: NGC 4033 lies in a low-density environment
NGC 4033's globular cluster color distribution is likely bimodal
Program 10554 studied globular cluster systems of ellipticals in low-density environments, including NGC 4033
